question: Does assuming identity with the waves of manifestation alter the ground of awareness?
premises: The cognitive treasures appear to assume identity with the flood of waves.
Awareness-Bhairava remains beautiful with the bliss of the world.
inference: Therefore even apparent identification with manifested waves does not depart from the blissful ground of awareness.
plain_english: having assumed all around an identity with the flood of those waves, still remain within awareness-Bhairava, who is beautiful with the bliss of the world.
